alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier ranked 'chocolate sauce' higher than 'ice cream', indicating the visual dominance of the syrup over the subject. The image lacks key diagnostic features of ice cream: distinct scoop ridges and visible air cells. It resembles a generic creamy dessert or mashed potatoes more than specific ice cream scoops. 7/9 checkpoints were marked present by the Router, but two critical geometric features (scoop marks, defined dome shape) are weak or absent, lowering the alignment score significantly below the base reference.

The severity is compounded by the lack of physical realism in the fluid dynamics of the syrup.
